title: RFI Lupus Research Program (LRP) Public
description: The Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs (CDMRP) seeks feedback to inform potential future Lupus Research Program (LRP) focus areas and associated research funding opportunities. Although fiscal year 2027 (FY27) funds have not been appropriated, the LRP is requesting this information to support program planning processes. The CDMRP wants to hear from all audiences, interested parties, and individuals from academia, industry, community and non-profit organizations, scientific and professional organizations, federal agencies, and the public. This RFI is for information and planning purposes only and should not be construed as a solicitation or an obligation on the part of the LRP or the Department of War. BACKGROUND: The CDMRP represents a unique partnership between the U.S. Congress, the military, and the public to fund innovative and impactful medical research in targeted program areas. The CDMRP LRP�s vision is to cure lupus through partnership of scientists, clinicians and persons affected by lupus. The LRP�s mission is to fund research to understand, prevent, and diagnose lupus and to improve treatments and quality of life of patients, including Service Members and their Families, Veterans and the general public. Appropriations for the LRP from FY17-24 and FY26 totaled $75 million. As of October 2026, FY27 funds for the LRP have not been appropriated. If appropriated, the CDMRP will utilize its two-tier review process https://cdmrp.health.mil/about/2tierRevProcess) to efficiently manage the LRP. Additional information about the LRP can be found here: https://cdmrp.health.mil/lrp/ RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS: Please provide responses to this RFI by clicking on the following link: https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/FY27-LRP-RFI

description: REQUEST FOR QUOTATION (RFQ) RFQ FA800326Q0012 1.0 GENERAL INFORMATION 1.1 Introduction, Background & Purpose. This Request for Quotation (RFQ) is a competitive action conducted on the open market as a Combined Synopsis/Solicitation in accordance with (IAW) Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. The Air Force Installation Contracting Center (AFICC) 771 ESS/EGA has a requirement for a comprehensive commercial audiovisual (AV) equipment lease/rental with incidental setup, teardown, and on-site technical standby support for the 2027 Nursing Practice Oversight Course (NPOC) Conference in support of Air Force Medical Command (AFMEDCOM). This requirement is a Total Small Business Set-Aside under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 532490 (Other Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing) and Product Service Code (PSC) W099 (Lease or Rental of Equipment: Miscellaneous). Be aware: FAR Part 15 procedures do NOT apply to this acquisition. The Government is not establishing a competitive range, conducting formal "discussions," or requesting "Final Proposal Revisions" (FPRs). The Government intends to evaluate quotations and award a contract without engaging in communications with Quoters. Therefore, Quoters are highly encouraged to submit their best technical and pricing terms in their initial quotation. The Government intends to award a single, Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract utilizing a Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) evaluation methodology. The Period of Performance (POP) is event-specific, running from 22 February 2027 through 24 February 2027. The event shall be held at Hotel Polaris, 8989 N Gate Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO 80921. 1.2 Government Points of Contact (POCs). The Contracting Officer (CO) and the Contract Specialist (CS) are the sole points of contact for this acquisition. All communication, including questions, shall be submitted in writing via email to both POCs listed below. Contracting Officer Contract Specialist Aubrey E. Frost, 771 ESS/EGA SSgt Luke P. Tiffany, 771 ESS/EGA Email: aubrey.frost.1@us.af.mil Email: luke.tiffany@us.af.mil 1.3 Critical Deadlines. All times are Eastern Time (ET). Questions & Answers. All questions must be submitted by 4:00 PM on MONDAY, 26 OCTOBER 2026. Questions must be submitted using the Q&A Spreadsheet (Attachment 5) format. Responses will be posted directly to SAM.gov (www.sam.gov). Quotation Submission. Quotations must be submitted by 4:00 PM on MONDAY, 16 NOVEMBER 2026. Quotations received after this deadline will not be considered for award. 1.4 General Terms and Conditions. Compliance: The quotation must comply with the terms and conditions of this RFQ. Non-conformance may result in an unfavorable evaluation or the quotation being removed from consideration. Discrepancies: If a Quoter believes these instructions contain an error, omission, or ambiguity, they shall immediately notify the Government POCs via email with supporting rationale prior to the quotation deadline. Exceptions: Any exceptions to the specific terms and conditions of this RFQ (e.g., the Statement of Work (SOW) or evaluation criteria) must be clearly identified and explained within the quotation's Cover Letter, detailing the specific RFQ document, page, paragraph, and a complete rationale. The Government reserves the right to deem any quotation containing exceptions unacceptable, which may result in the quote being ineligible for award. Site Visit: The Government will not host a coordinated site visit. Quoters are solely responsible for conducting their own site visits and due diligence at their proposed venues prior to quotation submission. Quote Validity Period: Quotations must stipulate that the quoted pricing and terms remain valid for a minimum of 160 days from the date of submission. 2.0 QUOTATION PREPARATION & SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS. 2.1 General Submission Instructions. description: The Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs (CDMRP) seeks feedback to inform potential future Lupus Research Program (LRP) focus areas and associated research funding opportunities. Although fiscal year 2027 (FY27) funds have not been appropriated, the LRP is requesting this information to support program planning processes. title: C-130, C-17 and C-5 Solid State Cockpit Voice Recording (SSCVR) and Solid-State Flight Data Recorder (SSFDR) and Amplifier Control Unit (ACU)
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation to announce that the Warner Robins Air Logistics Center (ALC), Robins AFB, GA, intends to solicit and negotiate on a competitive basis to procure the Amplifier Control Unit (ACU) and Solid-State Flight Data Recorder (SSFDR) for C-5, C-17, and C-130 aircraft. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; proposals are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. The Request for Quote (RFQ) number is FA8539-27-QB-002. This requirement contains the following National Stock Numbers (NSNs) and Part Numbers (P/Ns): Item Description National Stock Number (NSN) Part Number (P/N) Flight Data Recorder 6610-01-501-1161CX 2100-4042-53 Control Amplifier 5895-01-524-2752CX 93-A152-16B The issuing Contracting Office's DODAAC is FA8539; Address, AFSC/PZABA. The Government intends to award a one-year (12-month) Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Purchase Order. The period of performance shall begin upon the date of award and extend through final delivery, inspection, and acceptance of all required items, not to exceed one (1) year from the date of award. This acquisition is unrestricted and conducted using full and open competition. Competition is not limited to the OEM. An offeror may be the OEM, an authorized distributor, a reseller, a surplus dealer, or another responsible source able to furnish the exact, unmodified part with acceptable condition documentation and complete traceability to the manufacturer or authorized supply chain. All responsible sources may submit an offer that the Government will consider. This solicitation does not commit the Government to award a contract or pay proposal-preparation costs. The Government may reject any or all offers, cancel the solicitation, or waive informalities and minor irregularities when permitted and in the Government�s interest. Only a warranted Contracting Officer may bind the Government. Interested parties may identify their interest by submitting a proposal via email, to the following Robins AFB personnel: Contracting Officer: Reid Sawyer, email: reid.sawyer@us.af.mil Program Manager: Anthony Simmons email: anthony.simmons.12@us.af.mil Parties may also submit a Statement of Capabilities if not interested in submitting a proposal for this requirement. OMBUDSMAN: All potential offeror(s) should contact the Contracting Officer identified above for additional information and/or to communicate concerns, if any, concerning this acquisition. If the Contracting Officer does not satisfy your concerns, an Ombudsman has been appointed to hear serious concerns that are not resolved through established channels. The purpose of the Ombudsman is not to diminish the authority of the Program Manager, Program Director or the Contracting Officer, but to communicate serious contractor concerns, issues, disagreements, and recommendations to the appropriate government personnel. When requested, the Ombudsman will maintain strict confidentiality as to the source of the concern. The Ombudsman does not participate in the evaluation of the proposals or in the source selection process. When appropriate, potential offeror(s) may contact the Ombudsman, Mrs. Nicole Furlough, via email, at nicole.furlough@us.af.mil. PLEASE DO NOT EMAIL THE OMBUDSMAN FOR SOLICITATION/INFORMATION REQUESTS.

title: P-8A Ground Vibration Testing
description: The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) intends to issue a modification to a sole source delivery order previously awarded to the Boeing Company (Boeing), 7755 E Marginal Way S., Seattle, WA 98108-4002, to conduct a Ground Vibration Test to assess the feasibility of integrating additional stores onto existing P-8A wing stations for a Foreign Military Sales Customer. The anticipated period of performance is Q2 FY2027 through Q4 FY2027 with award anticipated in Q2 FY2027. These requirements will be procured in accordance with the statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition under Title 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1) as implemented by FAR 6.103-1, "Only One Responsible Source and No other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements." The Boeing P-8A team, consisting of the Boeing Commercial Airplanes (BCA) and Integrated Development Systems (IDS) Divisions, is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and sole designer, developer and manufacturer of the Boeing 737-800ERX P-8A airframe, as well as the sole systems integrator, and therefore is the only contractor with the requisite knowledge, experience, and technical data that can meet the Government's requirements on a timely basis. The Government does not possess adequate license rights to the required technical data package necessary to support a competitive procurement to fulfill the requirements described herein. THIS NOTICE IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. Interested parties may, however, identify their interest and capability by responding to the requirement. The Government will consider all information received prior to the closing of this synopsis. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. A determination by the Government not to compete the proposed contract action is solely at the discretion of the Government. No phone inquiries will be entertained. Responses shall be made in writing by E-mail or U.S. Mail to the attention of Jessica Dean, contract specialist or Brittney Davis, Procuring Contracting Officer using the contact information provided with this synopsis. However, the Government will consider all responses received within fifteen days after the publication date of this synopsis. Companies interested in subcontracting opportunities should contact Boeing Company (Boeing), 7755 E Marginal Way S., Seattle, WA 98108-4002 directly via Ms. Brittany Olden at the email brittany.d.olden@boeing.com.

title: Germany – Public road transport services – Vergabe von Personenbeförderungsleistungen im Linienverkehr mit Kraftfahrzeugen im Landkreis Böblingen, Verkehrsraum Linienbündel 2 "Strudelbach"
description: Der öffentliche Auftraggeber ist zuständiger Aufgabenträger im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr (ÖPNV) nach § 8 Abs. 3 Satz 1 PBefG i. V. m. § 6 Abs. 1 des Gesetzes über die Planung, Organisation und Gestaltung des öffentlichen Personennahverkehrs Baden-Württemberg (ÖPNVG BW). Der Auftraggeber ist gem. § 6 Abs. 3 ÖPNVG BW damit auch zuständige Behörde im Sinne der EU-Verordnung (EG) Nr. 1370/2007 (VO 1370/2007). Der Landkreis ist damit für die Sicherstellung eines ausreichenden Verkehrsangebots in seinem Wirkungskreis zuständig (§ 8 Abs. 3 PBefG). Nachdem die aktuelle Verkehrsbedienung im Linienbündel BB02 zum 30.06.2027 endet, war die Verkehrsleistung ab dem 01.07.2027 zu gewährleisten, mithin neu auszuschreiben. Zur Vergabe kommen die Busverkehrsleistungen auf den nachfolgenden aufgelisteten VVS-Linien: – Linie 634 Weissach - Flacht - Rutesheim - Leonberg – Linie 634A Weissach - Flacht - Perouse - Rutesheim (Schülerverkehr) – Linie N62 Leonberg - Gebersheim - Rutesheim - Perouse - Flacht - Weissach und zurück Es handelt sich ausschließlich um Linienverkehre die nach § 42 PBefG genehmigt werden sollen. Der Auftragnehmer hat den vorgegebenen Fahrplan zu erfüllen; dieser ist in Anhang LB.1 beigefügt. In Anhang LB.2 und Anhang LB.3 finden sich die zugehörigen Planungshilfen. Im Rahmen der Inbetriebnahme des Eisenbahninfrastrukturprojektes Stuttgart 21 (S21) kann es zu Verschiebungen im S-Bahn- und/ oder Regionalverkehr kommen. Die Deutsche Bahn hat im Juni 2026 eine stufenweise Inbetriebnahme ab vrsl. Dezember 2031 angekündigt. Daher sind die vorgegebenen Busfahrpläne nach Umstellung der S-Bahn- und/oder Regionalverkehre durch den Auftragnehmer auf Kompatibilität mit den dann geltenden S-Bahn- und/ oder Regionalverkehrsfahrplänen zu überprüfen. Mögliche Anpassungen sind mit dem Aufgabenträger und ggf. dem VVS rechtzeitig abzustimmen und umzusetzen. Das Letztentscheidungsrecht hat der Aufgabenträger. Der Auftraggeber stellt klar, dass es sich bei dem beschriebenen Mechanismus um Optionen im Sinne des § 132 Abs. 2 S. 1 Nr. 1 GWB handelt, welche im Falle einer, auch späteren, Inbetriebnahme von S 21 eine Auftragsänderung ohne Neuausschreibung ermöglichen. Die Auftragsvergabe fällt in den Anwendungsbereich der Richtlinie 2009/33/EG des Europäischen Parlaments und des Rates (Richtlinie zur Förderung sauberer Fahrzeuge — CVD). Näheres ist Ziff. 5.1. zu entnehmen.

title: Finland – Construction work – Rakennusurakointitöiden puitehankinta vuosille 2027-2029
description: Naantalin kaupungin yksiköt (Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia rakennusurakointitöiden toteuttamisesta sopimuskaudelle. Hankinnan kohteena olevat työt toteutetaan joko erikseen minikilpailutettavina toimeksiantoina tai suoraan hankittavina töinä sopimusehtojen mukaisesti. Rakennusurakoita kilpailutetaan lisäksi kohdekohtaisilla urakkakilpailulla. Sopimuskauden arvioitu alkamisajankohta on 1.1.2027. Lisäksi Tilaaja varaa mahdollisuuden kahteen optiovuoteen (1+1). Optiolla tarkoitetaan mahdollisuutta sopimuksen jatkamiseen alkuperäisin ehdoin. Tilaaja päättää optioiden käytöstä erikseen. Hankinta tullaan toteuttamaan puitejärjestelynä. Tilattavien töiden sisältö ja määrä eivät ole ennalta tiedossa eikä Tilaaja sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin sopimuskauden aikana. Pienurakat voivat sisältää rakennus-, maalaus-, matto-, tasoite-, vedeneristys- sekä laatoitus- ja teräsrakennetöitä. Urakat toteutetaan noudattaen rakennusalan yleisiä sopimusehtoja YSE 1998.

title: Finland – Financial and insurance services – Hankintailmoitus: LapIT Oy:n vakuutusturvan hankinnan kilpailutus
description: LapIT Oy (myöhemmin Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia vakuutusturvasta ja siihen liittyvistä palveluista tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. LapIT Oy:n vakuutusturva ja sen laajuus on kuvattu tarjouspyynnön liitteissä. Ensimmäinen vakuutuskausi on 1.1.2027-31.12.2027. Tämän jälkeen vakuutuskausi on kalenterivuosi. Tarjous jätetään alkaen täydestä kalenterivuodesta (2027). LapIT Oy:llä on oikeus vakuutuskausien aikana kilpailuttaa vakuutukset uudelleen ja siirtää vakuutukset kilpailutuksen voittajalle. Vakuutukset ovat voimassa toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Hankinnan sopimuskausi on kolme (3) vuotta, jonka jälkeen LapIT Oy:llä on oikeus jatkaa sopimuskautta yhdellä (1) kahden (2) vuoden optiokaudella. Optiokauden jälkeen LapIT Oy:llä on oikeus jatkaa hankintaa toistaiseksi voimassa olevana optiokautena. Lisähankintamahdollisuus: LapIT Oy varaa oikeuden laajentaa sopimusta, mikäli se perustuu hankintamenettelyn aikana tiedossa olleisiin ja hankinta-asiakirjoissa mainittuihin sopimusehtoihin tai niiden muuttamista koskeviin ehtoihin, niiden rahallisesta arvosta riippumatta, ja nämä ehdot ovat selkeät, täsmälliset ja yksiselitteiset, eivätkä ne muuta hankintasopimuksen yleistä luonnetta (1397/2016, 14 luku, 136 §, 2 mom., 1 kohta); tai mikäli alkuperäisen sopimuskumppanin on tarpeen suorittaa lisätöitä tai -palveluja taikka ylimääräisiä tavarantoimituksia, jotka eivät sisältyneet alkuperäiseen sopimukseen, ja jos sopimuskumppanin vaihtaminen ei ole mahdollista taloudellisista tai teknisistä syistä ja aiheuttaisi merkittävää haittaa tai kustannusten merkittävää päällekkäisyyttä hankintayksikölle (1397/2016, 14 luku, 136 §, 2 mom., 2 kohta). LapIT Oy on pohjoissuomalainen ICT -infra ja perustietotekniikan palveluita omistajilleen tuottava in-house -yhtiö. Omistajiimme kuuluu pohjoisen Suomen kuntia, hyvinvointialueita, kunta- ja hyvinvointialueyhtymiä sekä kuntaomisteisia osakeyhtiötä. LapIT Oy on velvollinen kilpailuttamaan tarvitsemansa palvelut markkinoilta hankintalain mukaisesti. title: Bulgaria – Repair and maintenance services of checking apparatus – „Изпълнение на дейности, свързани с пожарогасителни и пожароизвестителни системи на МВнР, с две обособени позиции“
description: Предметът на обществената поръчка е: „Изпълнение на дейности, свързани с пожарогасителни и пожароизвестителни системи на МВнР, с две обособени позиции“, както следва: Обособена позиция № 1: „Абонаментно обслужване на 2 бр. пожарогасителни системи, обхващащи помещение „сървър“ в подземното етажно ниво и помещение „архив ценни книжа“ на 7 етажно ниво в Централното управление на МВнР“. Предметът на обособената позиция включва ежемесечно абонаментно сервизно обслужване: планово-профилактични прегледи, техническа поддръжка и при необходимост – ремонт, на 2 бр. пожарогасителни системи, обхващащи помещение „сървър“ в подземното етажно ниво и помещение „архив ценни книжа“ на 7 етажно ниво в Централното управление на МВнР, с газообразно вещество FM-200 в МВнР, производство на ЕЛ ПИ ДЖИ С.А., Испания, за срок от 24 месеца. Обособена позиция № 2: „Абонаментно сервизно следгаранционно поддържане на пожароизвестителни системи „ZETFAS 3000”, „Унипос 7000“ и „Унипос 4000“, монтирани в обекти на МВнР“. Предметът на обособената позиция включва ежемесечно абонаментно сервизно обслужване: планово-профилактични прегледи, техническа поддръжка и при необходимост – ремонт, на пожароизвестителни системи „ZETFAS 3000”, „Унипос 7000“ и „Унипос 4000“, монтирани в обекти на МВнР, за срок от 12 месеца. Система „ZETFAS 3000” ще се поддържа до монтиране на нова пожароизвестителна система в ЦУ на МВнР. Система „ZETFAS 3000” се предава за обслужване в текущото си състояние. След отпадане на обслужването на „ZETFAS 3000”, при месечно обслужване ще се изплаща само стойността на обслужването на системи „Унипос 7000“ и „Унипос 4000“. Естеството и обемът на дейностите, предметът на възлагане, както и изискванията за изпълнение на поръчката, са подробно представени в Техническите спецификации за Обособени позиции № 1 и № 2, представляващи Приложение № 1 към настоящата документация. Условията, при които ще се реализира предметът на поръчката, правата и задълженията на страните, са подробно разписани в Проектите на договор за възлагане на обществената поръчка по Обособени позиции № 1 и № 2, представляващи Приложение № 2 към настоящата документация.

title: Germany – Electrical fitting work – Schnieglinger Str. 71 (147a) - Krematorium, Ofensanierung, 053.02 Elektrotechnik
description: 1. Gegenstand der ausgeschriebenen Leistung: Im Rahmen der Sanierung des Krematoriums Nürnberg, Westfriedhof, ist es erforderlich das Technikgebäude baulich zu erweitern. Dabei wird das Bestandsgebäude des Krematoriums saniert und umgebaut, sowie mit gleicher Traufhöhe erweitert. Die Erweiterung erfolgt in westlicher Richtung, damit maximal entfernt von dem historischen denkmalgeschützten Bestandsgebäudeteilen. Die vorliegende Ausschreibung umfasst Gerüstbauarbeiten. Als wichtige Randbedingung ist zu benennen, dass die Ausführung des Vorhabens in insgesamt fünf Bauphasen untergliedert ist und der Umbau/die Sanierung, sowie Erweiterung IM LAUFENDEN BETRIEB erfolgen müssen. Die Maßnahme umfasst abschnittsweise Bauleistungen, welche zum Teil komplexe Schnittstellen zur technischen Ausrüstung und zum Anlagenbau der Kremationsanlagen aufweisen. Ein Großteil der Gewerke und Leistungsbereiche wiederholt sich in den einzelnen Bauphasen.

title: Core Research Program Technology Transfer & Commercialization Advancement
description: The Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) Research and Development (R&D) Core Research Program announces this competitive solicitation for proposals focused strictly on Technology Transfer (T2) and Commercialization Advancement. The core objective of this Research Announcement is to accelerate the transition of high-impact pipeline safety innovations from advanced laboratory and operational prototypes to full-scale commercial deployment and operational field implementation across the Nation's energy transportation infrastructure. title: Energy Automation Operational Technology Systems (EAOTS) Automated Fuel Handling Equipment Maintenance
description: This acquisition is for services supporting the maintenance and sustainment of the installed Automated Fuel Handling Equipment (AFHE) located at 23 designated places of performance worldwide, which includes providing all personnel, equipment, materials, maintenance Program Management, and services to perform the maintenance for the AFHE systems and implementing equipment installation at these sites. This effort consists of Preventive Maintenance, Corrective Maintenance, Site Support, SCADA Maintenance, Support Documentation, Meter System Calibration, and Equipment and Material Support. All services including labor, equipment, materials, parts, tools, test equipment, transportation, and travel for maintaining and repairing equipment associated with the AFHE systems are encompassed under this effort; to include all services in support of design, procurement, installation, testing, subsystem/system implementation, system interfaces, training, documentation generation, integration and system troubleshooting of installations/modifications to the AFHE system. title: CVN 75 RCOH Painting, Decking and Lagging
description: DISCLOSURE: This is a Request for Information (RFI) notice only. This is not a Request for Proposal (RFP) and a formal solicitation is not available at this time. This RFI is for informational planning purposes and it is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to issue an RFP, contract, or order for any actual procurement of materials, machinery, supply or service. The Government will not pay for any effort expended or any material provided in response to this announcement. All costs associated with responding to this RFI are solely at the responding parties' expense. Responses to this notice are not offers and will not be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract or agreement. The Government will not be obligated to pursue any particular acquisition alternative because of this RFI. Responses to the RFI will not be returned. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future solicitation, if one is issued. Specific responses to the approaches will not disqualify or have an impact on participation and evaluation on future solicitations. No specific information is required in response to this RFI; however, interested parties may respond and indicate interest as desired. PURPOSE: This RFI is in support of market research being conducted by the PAE Maritime, Aircraft Carriers Program Office (PMS 312). The purpose of this Sources Sought is to solicit input via capability and experience statements from interested parties with the capabilities necessary to provide professional shipboard preservation, painting, decking, and lagging services. This contract covers the mobilization, surface preparation, application of specialized marine/facility coatings, deck installation, and thermal insulation (lagging) during the USS HARRY S. TRUMAN (CVN 75) Refueling Complex Overhaul (RCOH) availability. The work will be performed at Huntington Ingalls Industries-Newport News Shipbuilding�s (HII-NNS) facility. The anticipated scope of work will cover three primary disciplines: Preservation & Painting: Surface preparation (SSPC-SP3/SP10 mechanical cleaning or water blasting), primer application, and marine-grade epoxy finish coats on designated structures. Decking Installation: Underlayment preparation, leveling, and installation of non-skid, cosmetic, or standard commercial-grade decking systems. Lagging & Insulation: Removal of damaged insulation, and the subsequent fabrication and installation of pipe lagging, thermal blankets, and protective glass cloth jackets. REQUEST FOR INFORMATION: It is with the above understanding that DPAE Carriers and PMS 312 seeks responses from industry base on the information below:?? DPAE Carriers/PMS 312 seeks businesses who can support and/or provide the following owned or leased, but not limited to:? Facilities and storage locations? Equipment owned or leased? Paint labor and purchasing? Safety equipment? Training? Stock and non-stock material purchases? Service material? Alteration Installation Team (AIT) support? Professional support services? Engineering Services? Facility Management? Has your company provided support (prime or subcontracted) to DPAE Carriers in the past? If so, please provide contract number and summary of the work provided.? Please provide the following: Technical Capability Statement: Brief description of the firm's experience with marine or commercial painting, decking, and lagging projects within the last 3 years. Certifications: Proof of relevant quality standards (e.g., SSPC-QP1/QP2 for painting, or general ISO 9001/14001 Quality Management systems). Please ensure your response includes the following information: 1) organization name, point of contact, address, email address, website address, telephone number, size and type of ownership for the organization; and 2) tailored capability statements addressing the particulars of this effort including any limitations or concerns; 3) if significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, briefly address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements; and 4) if your company has an approved cost accounting system. SUBMISSION DETAILS: Responses and comments are requested by 1700 EST, on 16 November 2026. However, submissions will be accepted after this date, but feedback may not be as timely or contribute to PAE Maritime�s strategic planning process. Information should be e-mailed to Jim McGowan (james.f.mcgowan6.civ@us.navy.mil) and Angela Garais (angela.c.garais.civ@us.navy.mil). The Government is not obligated to respond to any or all questions or comments submitted in response to this RFI or information provided as a result of this request, but, the Navy will consider each question or comment received when making plans for the program or future information to be shared. Responses are requested to be provided electronically, with no less than 10-point font and acceptable formats include Adobe PDF, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft PowerPoint files. It is requested that there be a cover sheet with a one-page executive summary of the response and include the company details as well as the names, position title, city, state, phone and e-mail address of the subject matter experts who contributed to the response and the primary point of contact. The information provided will assist PAE Maritime in future developments, procurements, and acquisitions. Since DPAE Carriers includes Navy employees, Government support contractors, and participating new ship construction shipyards, the responses and comments provided should be segregated and labeled any proprietary information contained; and that portion will be treated as Business Sensitive and will not be shared with non-Government employees without the permission of the provider. Please clearly delineate in your responses any data that is shareable only with the U.S. Navy personnel and what can be shared with Navy support contractors and/or ship construction shipyards. Partial responses to this RFI are encouraged; a respondent need not respond to all questions for their responses to be considered. Follow-up questions may be asked of responders for clarification, but this will not indicate a selection or preference. Responders are advised that the U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this RFI. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future RFP or other solicitation, if any is issued. Classified material will not be accepted.

title: Y1DZ--598-22-115 Site Utility Infrastructure-NLR
description: This procurement will be issued as a 100% Set-Aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB) through RFP procedures under FAR 15. The Central Arkansas Veterans Healthcare System (CAVHS) has a requirement Upgrade/Replace Site Utility Infrastructure, Project #598-22-115. The tentative date for issuing the RFP is on or around November 17, 2026, with proposals due approximately 49 calendar days later on or around January 05, 2027. There will be no public bid opening. The period of performance is 720 calendar days after issuance of the Notice to Proceed. Location of the work is at the Eugene J. Towbin (EJT) VA Healthcare Center, 2200 Fort Roots Drive, North Little Rock, AR 72114. The point of contact for this notice is Contract Specialist, Julius Jones at Julius.Jones@va.gov.Telephone requests will NOT be accepted. Abbreviated Scope of Work: The scope of this project includes upgrading the water source, storage, and site distribution system at the North Little Rock (NLR) Veterans Affairs Medical Center (VAMC) campus: All work shall be done is a manner and sequence to minimize impact to the campus, patients, visitors and staff. No prolonged outages are permitted and any activity affecting the campus shall be coordinated in advance. See additional sections for detailed information. The NLR campus is short of reserve water capacity. This project includes a new elevated water storage tank. The new tank installation shall include all labor and materials required for a complete and operational system including, but not limited to, supporting structure, piping, appurtenances, and accessories as required. The existing elevated 250,000-gallon water tower shall be demolished in its entirety including all below grade supporting structure, piping vaults, etc. The demolition shall be in strict accordance with the phasing schedule. A new pump house with new pumps and new pump controls is included in this project. Physical and operational security, monitoring, controls, redundancy and emergency power are included. The new pump house installation shall include all labor and materials required for a complete and operational system including, but not limited to, structure, fence, paving, piping, cameras, access control, emergency generator, appurtenances, and accessories as required. A new automated control system that interlocks to and also controls the existing south pump house as well as the new north pump house is included in this project. The new system shall be seamlessly integrated into the existing automation system currently operating the south pump house. This project also replaces all existing, failing cast iron, ductile iron, galvanized, asbestos cement, and/or any other material water pipe with new pipe as shown on the project plans. The water supply lines are generally looped to improve supply redundancy and improve the water pressure. Additionally, new backflow preventers shall be installed on the Fire Protection supply lines to buildings which have fire protection systems. This installation will include pressure testing, disinfecting, and hyper-chlorinating as required for new piping installation per Federal, State, and Local codes. Multiple phases are required and part of the project. 237110 Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction is applicable to the RFP, and the Small Business Size Standard is $45M. Interested offerors are asked to first read over the RFP and all its associated attachments/documents in their entirety prior to forwarding any questions to the Contracting Officer. A cut-off time/date for receipt of questions will be established and listed in the RFP, as well as a time/date for the scheduled Site Visit. Only one Site Visit will be conducted and no requests for additional Site visits or make-up Site Visits will be granted. The RFP number for this project is 36C25626R0084. The RFP will be posted and can be downloaded (without charge) from the SAM.gov website. Amendments to the RFP will not be mailed but will be posted at the SAM.gov website. Offerors are responsible for obtaining the RFP (and associated documents/attachments) from the SAM.gov website and for acknowledging all amendments to the RFP. It is the responsibility of all interested offerors to check the SAM.gov website as necessary for any Amendments to the RFP (to include the day bids are due). In accordance with VAAR 819.7003 Eligibility, at the time of submission of a proposal, the offeror must represent to the Contracting Officer that it is a SDVOSB concern, that it is a small business concern under the NAICS Code assigned to the acquisition, and that it is verified for eligibility in the Small Business Association website (Veteran Small Business Certification (VetCert)) and have the Veterans Small Business Certification. SDVOSB concerns must also be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database at www.sam.gov. DISCLAIMER: This Pre-solicitation Notification is NOT a Solicitation. In accordance with FAR 15.201(e), responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. Any liability associated with the submission of information in response to this notice is the responsibility of the submitting contractor. The Government shall not be held responsible or liable for any information submitted, or for any costs associated with the submitted information.

buyer: Stadt Lörrach - Fachbereich Stadtentwicklung und Stadtplanung
title: Offener zweiphasiger städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischer Realisierungswettbewerb als vorgeschalteter Planungswettbewerb für eine Vergabe im Verhandlungsverfahren nach VgV "Zukunft Krankenhaus-Areal Lörrach"
description: In absehbarer Zukunft werden die Kreiskliniken des Landkreises Lörrach und das St.Elisabethen-Krankenhaus im neuen Zentralklinikum Lörrach (Dreiland-Klinikum- Lörrach), im Nordosten der Stadt vereint. In diesem Zusammenhang wird auch der Standort des Kreiskrankenhauses in Lörrach aufgegeben. Das ca. 3,5 ha große innenstadtnahe Areal zwischen der Röntgenstraße im Süden, der Spitalstraße im Osten, der Körnerstraße im Norden und dem Gewerbekanal „Neuer Teich“ im Westen, wird an die Stadt Lörrach zurückfallen und für eine Folgenutzung frei. Das Krankenhaus-Areal ist einer der wichtigen Transformationsorte der Stadt und im Kontext mit der Weiterentwicklung der Gesamtstadt zu sehen. Die Entwicklung des Areals soll dementsprechend im Kontext der Stärkung Lörrachs als urbane und lebenswerte Stadt in der Region verstanden werden. Ziel ist es, mutige, innovative und unkonventionelle Entwurfsansätze zu entwickeln, die den gegenwärtigen Städtebau hinterfragen und eine auf Lörrach zugeschnittene neue Urbanität schaffen, die Klimaanpassung mit Nutzungsmischung, soziale Teilhabe und Mehrgenerationenfähigkeit konsequent und resilient umsetzt. Das künftige Areal soll unter möglicher Berücksichtigung des Teilerhalts vorhandener Strukturen und der Umnutzung einiger potenzieller Gebäudeteile als urbanes Quartier neu überplant werden. Ziel ist es, ein zukunftsfähiges Quartier zu schaffen und zusätzlich eine Perspektive für die Weiterentwicklung der unmittelbaren Umgebung und angrenzender Gebiete vor-zubereiten. Die städtebauliche und freiraumplanerische Transformation des Areals, in Etappen und langfristig, ermöglicht ein innenstadtnahes durchmischtes Quartier mit dem Schwerpunkt auf Wohnen und Nutzungen der Gesundheitsvorsorge, Erholung sowie sozialer und gewerblicher Infrastruktur und vereint eine angemessene zukunftsorientiere Dichte mit innerstädtischen Freiräumen und Klimaanpassung. Wettbewerbsgegenstand: Städtebaulich-freiraumplanerische Vorentwurfsplanung (Leistungsphase 2) für das künftige urbane Quartier in Lörrach. Wettbewerbsverfahren: Offener zweiphasiger städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischer Realisierungswettbewerb gemäß der RPW 2013, mit anschließendem Verhandlungsverfahren nach der VgV. Die Beurteilung und Auswahl der Teilnehmer*innen in der ersten Phase, die für die Bearbeitung des städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischen Realisierungswettbewerb (2. Phase) zugelassen werden, erfolgt anhand einer „Kreativaufgabe“ durch das Preisgericht. Der Wettbewerb wird im Rahmen der VgV 2016, i.V.m. § 3 Abs. 3 RPW 2013 durchgeführt und ist anonym (gemäß § 1 Abs. 4 der RPW 2013). Im Anschluss an das Wettbewerbsverfahren, nach Abschluss der 2. Phase, werden gemäß § 14 Abs. 4 Ziff. 8 VgV die Preisträger*innen zu Vergabeverhandlungsgesprächen eingeladen. Beauftragung: Die Ausloberin wird, unter Würdigung der Empfehlungen des Preisgerichts, eine*n der Preisträger*innen (§ 8 Abs. 2 RPW 2013) mit der Leistungsphase 3 des städtebaulichen Entwurfs und der Leistungsphase 3 des freiräumlichen Entwurfs beauftragen. Gemäß der Vergaberichtlinien nach VgV sind mit allen Preisträger*innen Verhandlungsgespräche zu führen. Rechtsgrundlage: Richtlinien 2014/24/EU VgV - Verordnung über die Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge - Deutsch RPW 2013 - Richtlinie für Planungswettbewerbe - Deutsch Teilnahmeberechtigt sind: Natürliche Personen, die gemäß Rechtsvorschrift ihres Heimatlandes am Tag der Bekanntmachung zur Führung einer der folgenden Berufsbezeichnungen berechtigt sind (Richtlinie 2005/36/EG Berufsanerkennungsrichtlinie): Stadtplaner*in, Landschaftsarchitekt*in, Architekt*in. Interdisziplinäre Bewerber*innen oder interdisziplinäre Bewerbergemeinschaften, die die fachlichen Voraussetzungen erfüllen. Fachliche Voraussetzungen sind die Berechtigungen zur Führung der folgenden Berufsbezeichnungen gemäß Rechtsvorschrift des Herkunftsstaates: Stadtplaner*in, Landschaftsarchitekt*in, Architekt*in. Erfüllt ein*e Bewerber*in die fachliche Voraussetzung allein oder zusammen mit fest angestellten Mitarbeitern*innen ist er*sie allein teilnahmeberechtigt. (Der*die Mitarbeiter*in / die Mitarbeiter*innen ist / sind in der Verfassererklärung explizit zu nennen.) Bei juristischen Personen sind die fachlichen Anforderungen erfüllt, wenn der satzungsgemäße Geschäftszweck Planungsleistungen sind, die der Wettbewerbsaufgabe entsprechen. Außerdem muss der*die zu benennende bevollmächtigte Vertreter*in und der oder die Verfasser*innen der Wettbewerbsarbeit insgesamt die oben genannte fachliche Anforderung erfüllen. Ist in dem Herkunftsstaat die Berufsbezeichnung nicht gesetzlich geregelt, so erfüllt die entsprechende fachliche Anforderung, wer über ein Diplom, Prüfungszeugnis oder sonstigen Befähigungsnachweis verfügt, dessen Anerkennung gemäß der Richtlinie 2013/55/EU- „Berufsanerkennungsrichtlinie“ - gewährleistet ist. Mehrfachbeteiligungen natürlicher oder juristischer Personen oder von Mitgliedern von Bewerbergemeinschaften führen zum Ausschluss der Beteiligten. Teilnahmehindernisse sind in § 4 Abs. 2 RPW beschrieben. Sachverständige, Fachplaner*innen, Berater*innen müssen die Teilnahmebedingungen nicht erfüllen. buyer: BEW Berliner Energie und Wärme GmbH
title: Germany – Construction work – DSP - Pumpenhaus Scharnhorststraße Dezentral
description: Das Projekt DSP – Dezentral Scharnhorststraße Pumpenhaus ist eine Infrastrukturmaßnahme zur Erweiterung und Modernisierung des Heizwerks Scharnhorststraße. Am Standort Scharnhorststraße wird eine neue Wärmeübertragerstation mit zwei Pumpengruppen, Rohrleitungssystemen sowie den erforderlichen elektro- und leittechnischen Einrichtungen in einer „Brownfield-Umgebung“ errichtet. Die Umsetzung erfolgt innerhalb eines bestehenden Heizwerksstandortes in einer Brownfield-Umgebung. Neben der Errichtung neuer Anlagenkomponenten sind zahlreiche Schnittstellen zu bestehenden Anlagen, Rohrleitungssystemen, elektro- und leittechnischen Einrichtungen sowie betrieblichen Prozessen zu berücksichtigen. Besonderes Augenmerk liegt dabei auf der Aufrechterhaltung der Versorgungssicherheit und die Umsetzung aller relevanten Umschlussarbeiten innerhalb eines drei (3) monatigen Stillstandsfensters. Für die Umsetzung des Projektes werden in einem vorgelagerten Projekt bereits die erforderlichen Voraussetzungen zur Baufeldfreimachung geschaffen. Aufbauend darauf umfasst das Projekt DSP die Ausführungsplanung, Beschaffung, Errichtung, Inbetriebsetzung und Übergabe der neuen Anlagentechnik einschließlich aller hierfür erforderlichen Nebenleistungen. Auszuführende Arbeiten: • Montage und Umbau von Fernwärme-Anlagenkomponenten • Installation und Integration von Pumpensystemen mit elektrischer Antriebstechnik • Rohrleitungsbau für Fernwärmeanwendungen einschließlich Verbindung und Einbindung von Anlagenteilen (Nennweiten ca. DN 200 bis DN 600) • Anbindung neuer Rohrleitungen und Komponenten an bestehende Versorgungs- und Rohrleitungssysteme • Lieferung und Montage von Armaturen, Regel- und Absperreinrichtungen (Nennweiten ca. DN 250 bis DN 600) • Planung und Errichtung von Rohrleitungsbefestigungen sowie unterstützenden Stahlbaukonstruktionen • Einbindung bestehender Anlagenkomponenten in neu errichtete Systeme • Herstellung von Fundamenten für Anlagen- und Stahlbaukomponenten • Anpassung und Erweiterung von Niederspannungs-, Energieversorgungs- und Antriebssystemen • Anpassung und Erweiterung von Mess-, Steuerungs- und Leittechnik • Erneuerung elektrischer Energieversorgungsanlagen einschließlich Kabelverlegung • Demontage und Rückbau bestehender Anlagen- und Rohrleitungskomponenten (Nennweiten bis ca. DN 500) Die Anbindungen an das Netz erfolgen auf dem Betriebsgelände. Die oberirdische Zuführung der beiden DN500 Leitungen auf dem Betriebsgelände auf einem bestehenden Stahlbau gehört zum Projektumfang. Die vorhandene und zu erweiternde Leittechnik ist auf dem Betriebsgebäude verortet. Die Planung der E- und Leittechnik sind Bestandteil vom Projektumfang. Schnittstellen zur bestehenden E- und Leittechnik sind vorhanden und zu berücksichtigen.

description: El objeto del contrato es la prestación del servicio de cafetería, cocina/comedor y la accesoria de instalación y explotación de máquinas dispensadoras automáticas de bebidas calientes, frías y productos sólidos (vending) para el personal de la Guardia Civil que presta sus servicios en el Acuartelamiento y sedes de la Comandancia de la Guardia Civil de A Coruña y Zona de Galicia, sitas en C/Médico Devesa Núñez, 3, 15008 A Coruña, así como otro personal militar y civil autorizado. El contrato se califica como concesión de servicios: el concesionario se retribuye mediante los precios abonados por los usuarios, asumiendo el riesgo operacional, sin precio ni gasto a cargo de la Administración. Valor estimado: 575.877,21 euros, IVA excluido. Duración: dos años desde el 22/12/2026, prorrogable por periodos anuales hasta un máximo de cuatro años. Procedimiento restringido con tramitación urgente: se invitará a presentar oferta a todos los candidatos que acrediten la solvencia exigida, con un mínimo de cinco. Los criterios de selección son exclusivamente los del apartado 8 del Cuadro de Características: volumen anual de negocios en la actividad hostelera igual o superior a 35.000 euros; relación de servicios realizados; declaración de maquinaria, material y equipo técnico; y formación en manipulación de alimentos. No se exigen medidas de gestión medioambiental.

title: Germany – Investigation and security services – Rahmenvereinbarung Sicherheitsdienste Sammelanhörungen, LfAR, München
description: Das Bayerische Landesamt für Asyl und Rückführungen (LfAR) führt in regelmäßigen Abständen Sammelanhörungen zur Klärung der Identität von mutmaßlichen Staatsangehörigen eines Herkunftslandes durch. Der Auftrag umfasst die Bewachung, den Objektschutz sowie die Personenkontrolle für den Zeitraum dieser Sammelanhörung. Der AN erbringt die Bewachungsdienstleistung nach gesonderter Einzelbeauftragung durch den AG an circa 25 bis 60 Werktagen im Jahr. Die Dauer der jeweiligen (Einzel-)Einsätze variiert grundsätzlich zwischen 1 bis 20 Werktagen. Die tägliche Einsatzzeit wird im Rahmen des jeweiligen Einzelabrufes festgelegt. Die tägliche Rahmenzeit der täglichen Einsatzzeiten beträgt grundsätzlich von 08:00 Uhr bis 20:00 Uhr. Die Höchstabrufmenge beträgt für das Bewachungspersonal 24.000 Einsatzstunden und für den Schichtleiter 2.400 Einsatzstunden.

title: Germany – Administrative educational services – V/GF/2026/17/BT2028
description: Auf Beschluss der KMK ist für das Jahr 2028 der erste Ländervergleich zum Erreichen der weiterentwickelten Bildungsstandards für den Primarbereich vorgesehen. Dazu werden ca. 31.850 Schülerinnen und Schüler der 4. Klasse in allen 16 Bundesländern neu entwickelte digitale Kompetenztests in den Fächern Deutsch und Mathematik bearbeiten. Zudem werden den beteiligten Schülerinnen und Schülern, Lehrkräften und Schulleitungen sowie den Eltern bzw. Erziehungsberechtigten der Kinder Fragebögen vorgelegt. Die Ergebnisse des IQB-Bildungstrends 2028 werden in einem Berichtsband dokumentiert und voraussichtlich im Herbst 2029 der Öffentlichkeit vorgestellt. Der hier zu vergebende Auftrag umfasst die Vorbereitung des IQB-Bildungstrends 2028 (einschließlich der Ziehung einer bundesweit und auf Ebene der 16 Bundesländer repräsentativen Stichprobe), ihre Durchführung (Feldarbeit und Datenerhebung), die Datenerfassung und -aufbereitung, die Erstellung von Fallgewichten sowie den Versand von Schulrückmeldungen an die teilnehmenden Schulen. Für weitergehende Informationen zu der zu vergebenden Leistung wird auf die Leistungsbeschreibung verwiesen

title: Germany – Urban environmental development planning – 10012255-Short Term Expert Support on Sustainable and Inclusive Mobility in Colombia
description: ProMOVIS II, implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), supports Colombian cities in strengthening their capacities to deliver public transport systems that better serve their populations. Colombia has committed to ambitious climate targets under its Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), requiring a 51% reduction in projected emissions by 2030. The transport sector accounts for approximately 45% of energy related GHG emissions nationwide, making the decarbonization of urban transport one of the country's most impactful mitigation opportunities. Despite ongoing efforts, the integration of public transport systems at local and regional levels remains insufficient, affected by the lasting effects of the pandemic, financing gaps, low digitalization, and early stage regional integration, particularly critical in metropolitan regions with high intermunicipal commuting, such as Valle del Cauca. Within this context, ProMOVIS II concentrates technical cooperation efforts on strengthening public transportation, incorporating a regional integration perspective and initially focusing its actions on Valle del Cauca. The objective is that public transport in selected Colombian cities is more integrated, inclusive and environmentally friendly, pursued through three outcomes: (1) number of people benefiting from newly created or improved public transport; (2) funds secured by selected cities to finance environmentally friendly, integrated public transport projects; and (3) number of bus operators and transport authorities that assess that professionals trained in green jobs training formats contribute positively to integrated, inclusive and environmentally friendly public transport. Through technical assistance, financing-related support, and knowledge exchange, ProMOVIS II addresses the institutional, organizational and operational challenges that limit the effective integration and sustainability of public transport systems, working closely with national and local governments, transport authorities and other stakeholders to strengthen local capacities and develop solutions that are replicable, scalable and sustainable over time.

Die Bereiche der ehemaligen Wartesäle und des Westflügels sind unterkellert. Das Gebäude wurde in dunkelrotem Backstein errichtet, die einzelnen Bauteile sind mit Walm- und Satteldächern versehen. Die Fassaden sind durch Lisenen und Gesimse zurückhaltend gegliedert. Besonders hervorgehoben ist die Giebelseite mit dem Haupteingang durch Verwendung dekorativer Bachsteinverbände sowie ein lebhaft gestaltetes Giebelgesims. Im Zuge dieses Bauvorhabens wird das Bahnhofsgebäude grundlegend saniert, umgebaut und erweitert.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – FFH-Monitoring Wildkatze Berichtsperiode 2025-2030
description: In der FFH-Richtlinie werden für die Europäische Union insgesamt 231 Lebensraumtypen (Anhang I, davon 93 in Deutschland vorkommend) und rund 1000 Arten und Unterarten (Anhang II, davon 143 in Deutschland vorkommend) von gemeinschaftlichem Interesse aufgelistet, für die ein System vernetzter Schutzgebiete eingerichtet werden muss. Gemäß Artikel 17 der FFH-Richtlinie sind die Mitgliedsstaaten dazu verpflichtet, der EU-Kommission alle 6 Jahre einen nationalen Bericht zum Stand der Umsetzung der Richtlinie zu übermitteln und darin die Erhaltungszustände aller auf den Anhängen verzeichneten Lebensraumtypen (LRT) und Arten zu bewerten. In Deutschland erfolgt die Erstellung des Berichtes überwiegend auf der Grundlage von Daten der Länder, die auf bundesweit einheitlichen Erhebungsmethoden basieren. Auf der Grundlage der Berichte der Mitgliedsstaaten erstellt die EU-Kommission einen Gemeinschafts-bericht. Der Artikel 11 der FFH-Richtlinie verpflichtet die Mitgliedsstaaten zur Überwachung des Erhaltungszustandes (Monitoring) der FFH-Schutzgüter (LRT (Anhang I) und Arten (Anhänge II, IV und V)). In einem mehrjährigen Abstimmungsprozess haben Bund und Länder sich auf ein bundesweites Vorgehen beim FFH-Monitoring geeinigt. Für das Monitoring werden auf Bundesebene die Anzahl der Stichprobenflächen (SPF) je Schutzgut (LRT oder Art) auf die Bundesländer (Bundesstichprobe) verteilt. Je Schutzgut werden dabei max. 63 SPF je biogeografischer Region innerhalb und außerhalb von FFH-Gebieten verteilt, bei weniger Vorkommen eines Schutzgutes als 63 je biogeografischer Region werden alle Vorkommen in einem Totalzensus (TZ) überprüft.

title: Germany – General management consultancy services – 10035189-Advice on implementation of AfCFTA Digital Trade Protocol and technical inputs to related reforms; facilitation and development of partnerships with the private sector on digital trade
description: The project "Pan-African e-Commerce Initiative 3 - Boosting African Digital Trade" (PeCI 3) is a regional technical cooperation project implemented by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) in the context of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). The project aims to strengthen an enabling environment for cross-border digital trade in Africa, with a particular focus on micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), including women-led businesses. PeCI 3 contributes to the BMZ"s core area "Sustainable Economic Development, Training and Employment" and supports it"s digital policy and Africa Strategy through the promotion of inclusive digital trade ecosystems, and public-private cooperation. The project builds on the achievements and partnerships established under the previous phases (PeCI 1 and PeCI 2). Earlier phases supported MSMEs in adopting e-commerce solutions and digital sales channels, strengthened intermediary organisations providing training and advisory services, facilitated public-private exchange on digital trade issues and contributed to regional approaches related to e-commerce, digital payments, consumer protection and electronic transactions. The project also strengthened cooperation with the East African Community (EAC), the Smart Africa Alliance (SAA) and the AfCFTA Secretariat. PeCI 3 supports implementation of the AfCFTA Digital Trade Protocol (DTP), adopted by the African Union in 2024, by strengthening structures, processes and cooperation mechanisms required for cross-border digital trade. The project addresses barriers affecting MSME participation in digital trade, including fragmented regulatory frameworks, limited interoperability of digital payment systems, logistics and last-mile delivery challenges, gaps in online consumer protection and limited coordination between public and private actors. Particular attention is given to barriers affecting women"s participation in digital trade ecosystems. The project operates at pan-African, regional and national levels and combines technical advisory services, stakeholder consultations, public-private dialogue formats and capacity development measures. Activities include support for implementation of selected DTP chapters, facilitation of cross-border exchange on best practices, development of cooperation models between private-sector actors and intermediary organisations, and support for gender-sensitive approaches to digital entrepreneurship and MSME support services. Environmental sustainability is integrated as a cross-cutting topic, including approaches related to sustainable packaging and resource-efficient logistics. The project is implemented in cooperation with public, private and regional stakeholders in selected AfCFTA countries, particularly Ghana and Kenya, as well as with the EAC. Lead executing agencies are the Ministry of Finance in Ghana, the Ministry of Investments, Trade and Industry (MITI) in Kenya and the EAC Secretariat. Additional partners include the AfCFTA Secretariat, the Smart Africa Secretariat, chambers of commerce, business and e-commerce associations, payment service providers, logistics companies, innovation hubs and women"s business networks. PeCI 3 further aims to strengthen cooperation between African, German and European private-sector actors to promote cross-border digital trade and MSME participation. The project cooperates with business associations, e-commerce platforms, logistics and payment providers, chambers of commerce and innovation actors, including bevh, AHKs and African e-commerce associations. Cooperation with UNCTAD, ITC and initiatives supported by the European Union and the World Bank further strengthens synergies and regional outreach. The project is scheduled to run until June 2028.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Delft-FEWS Konfiguration 2026-2030
description: Die Bundesanstalt für Gewässerkunde (BfG) ist Bundesoberbehörde im Geschäftsbereich des Bundesministeriums für Verkehr (BMV) mit Sitz in Koblenz. Als wissenschaftliches Institut des Bundes für Forschung auf den Gebieten Gewässerkunde, Wasserwirtschaft, Gewässerschutz sowie Ökologie berät sie Bundesministerien und deren nachgeordnete Dienststellen. Die BfG berät gleichermaßen die Behörden der Wasserstraßenund Schifffahrtsverwaltung (WSV) hinsichtlich der Planung, des Aus- und Neubaus sowie des Betriebes und der Unterhaltung der Bundeswasserstraßen (BWStr). Ergänzende Informationen sind auf der Internetseite http://www.bafg.de verfügbar. Im Auftrag von BMV und WSV erstellt die BfG auch Vorhersagemodelle und -systeme für die Binnenwasserstraßen, pflegt und entwickelt diese Systeme kontinuierlich weiter. Darüber hinaus erstellt und veröffentlicht die BfG operationell wie präoperationell Vorhersagen für ausgewählte Wasserstraßen. Die bestehenden sowie zukünftigen Vorhersagesysteme des Bundes für die Binnenwasserstraßen basieren auf der Software Delft-FEWS. Aktuell werden mit dem Delft-FEWS System bei der BfG Wasserstand- und Abflussvorhersagen für die Gebiete von Rhein, Donau, Elbe, Eder, Weser und Nord-Ostsee-Kanal erstellt. Hinzu kommen Eisvorhersagen für Mittelland- und Elbe-Seitenkanal sowie die Aufbereitung hydrometeorologischer Mess- und Vorhersagedaten für alle deutschen Flussgebiete inkl. ihrer ausländischen Anteile. Das System ist entsprechend umfangreich mit aktuell über 1000 Konfigurationsdateien (ca. 540 Workflow-Files und ca. 900 ModuleConfig- Files). Konkret in der Planung befinden sich zudem ein Vorhersagesystem für die Eider und die Erweiterung des Vorhersagehorizontes an Rhein und Elbe auf bis zu 6 Monate. Letzteres ist aktuell Forschungsgegenstand und wird zukünftig in das Vorhersagesystem überführt. Zur Unterstützung der Arbeiten der BfG bei der Aktualisierung und Weiterentwicklung der Delft-FEWS-Konfiguration sind die im Folgenden skizzierten Tätigkeiten durch einen Auftragnehmer im Zeitraum 2026 - 2030 zu erbringen. Um die mit dem BfG-Personal engverzahnte und vielfach iterativ durchzuführende Bearbeitung fachlich zu realisieren sowie aus technischen Rahmenbedingungen bei der BfG, kann es in Einzelaufträgen erforderlich sein, dass auch Leistungen in nennenswertem Umfang beim Auftraggeber am Dienstsitz der BfG in Koblenz zu erbringen sind. Die Pflicht zur Anwesenheit bei der BfG wird auf das fachlich wie technisch erforderliche Mindestmaß reduziert. Zur Erfüllung diesbezüglicher Anforderungen werden von einem im Rahmen der EVB-IT Rahmenvereinbarung von IT-Dienstleistungen zu beauftragendem Dienstleister die in dieser Tätigkeitsbeschreibung definierten Leistungen erforderlich. Die jeweils zu erbringenden Leistungen in den unterschiedlichen Leistungspunkten werden in Einzelaufträgen detailliert spezifiziert (Tätigkeiten, Auftragsvolumen, Fristen) und werden nach Aufwand abgerechnet. title: Germany – Business services: law, marketing, consulting, recruitment, printing and security – 10032182-Building the capacities of smallholder farmers on agriculture best practices, and climate smart agriculture in Upper Egypt
description: The Agricultural Innovation Project Phase II (AIP II) is an Egyptian-German Technical Cooperation project commissioned by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented by Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH in cooperation with the Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation (MALR). The project runs until the end of 2029 and aims to increase the income and resilience of smallholder farmers and rural entrepreneurs in Upper Egypt through market-oriented agricultural innovations and climate-resilient production practices. Under co-financing by the Swiss Development Cooperation (SDC/DEZA) and the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO), AIP II contributes to the LAND-at-Scale (LAS) programme, particularly through activities related to Participatory Land-Use Consolidation (LUC), climate resilience and inclusive business models. The intervention focuses on strengthening agricultural productivity, climate resilience, market integration and the provision of improved services to smallholder farmers. The assignment covers the governorates of Beni Suef, Minya, Asyut and Sohag and targets selected value chains, including medicinal and aromatic plants (MAPs) such as basil, chamomile, mint, marjoram, fennel, anise and geranium, as well as onions, garlic, tomatoes, sesame, soybeans and green beans. The assignment forms part of AIP II Output 1, which focuses on enhancing the climate resilience and productivity of smallholder farmers. It aims to strengthen the capacities of approximately 9,000 smallholder farmers and 200 rural stakeholders, including agricultural extension services, cooperatives, agriculture-related enterprises, community leaders and young professionals. A key feature of the intervention is the application of a Living Lab approach. The Living Lab provides a multi-stakeholder framework for co-creating, testing, validating and scaling agricultural innovations under real-life conditions. It brings together farmers, multipliers, community leaders, research institutions and public and private sector actors. The approach is complemented by Farmer Field School (FFS) methods, which provide a practical and farmer-centred learning and experimentation tool within the broader Living Lab framework. The conceptualisation and transition phases of the Living Lab approach are implemented by the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF). The present assignment covers the subsequent scaling-up phase. The selected service provider will implement the validated solutions through Interactive Demo Plots, field visits, training and knowledge exchange, while supporting inclusive business models and Land-Use Consolidation. The overall intervention is designed to strengthen the adoption and scaling of climate-smart agriculture (CSA), Good Agricultural Practices (GAP), post-harvest practices and market-oriented solutions, thereby contributing to more productive, sustainable and climate-resilient agricultural systems in Upper Egypt.

description: Objet des fournitures : Accord-cadre multi-attributaires pour la fourniture de matériels de plomberie, chauffage et sanitaire. Commentaire : Le présent marché a pour objet la conclusion d’un accord-cadre multi-attributaires pour la fourniture de matériels nécessaires aux interventions de la régie technique de la société de logement de service public. Les fournitures comprennent des accessoires et produits de plomberie, sanitaires et de chauffage. Il s'agit d’un marché public de fournitures. Le marché est conclu sous la forme d’un accord-cadre avec un maximum de trois attributaires, pour une durée de quatre ans. Les commandes seront exécutées selon un système en cascade. L’adjudicataire ne livre pas l’ensemble des fournitures en une fois, mais par livraisons fractionnées sur base de bons de commandes successifs au gré des besoins du pouvoir adjudicateur, pendant toute la durée du marché. Le marché porte sur la totalité des produits repris dans l’inventaire ci-joint ET du catalogue du soumissionnaire, dont les articles font partie de l’objet du présent marché. Par conséquent, le pouvoir adjudicateur aura accès au catalogue de l’adjudicataire moyennant une remise. Le pouvoir adjudicateur disposera d’un compte client, permettant le suivi des commandes, suivi des livraisons, accès aux fiches techniques du matériel et état du stock. Le soumissionnaire fournira, avec son offre, un compte client temporaire pour que l’adjudicateur puisse tester l’interface du catalogue en ligne. Au moment de la rédaction des conditions du présent marché, l’administration n’est pas en mesure de définir avec précision les quantités de fournitures dont elle aura besoin. En conséquence, les quantités présumées indiquées dans le présent cahier spécial des charges régissant le présent marché sont à titre purement indicatif et elles n’engagent nullement l’administration. Le marché est attribué au(x) soumissionnaire(s) dont l’offre est régulière et économiquement la plus avantageuse. Le classement établi lors de l’analyse des offres déterminera l’ordre de recours aux fournisseurs dans le cadre d'un système en cascade. Les commandes sont d’abord adressées au fournisseur le mieux classé. En cas d’indisponibilité d’un article ou de délai de livraison non respecté, la commande est passée au fournisseur suivant dans le classement. L’indisponibilité devra être confirmée par écrit par le fournisseur concerné dans un délai de 24h ouvrables. Les fournitures seront livrées au siège de la slsp. Le délai standard de livraison doit être indiqué et ne pourra excéder 48 heures ouvrables sauf exception. La livraison s’effectue sur base de bon de commande signé. Une vérification qualitative et quantitative sera effectuée à la réception. Le marché peut être reconduit tacitement 3 fois. Lieu de livraison : 5503 Sorinnes rue du Saxophone 97 (ou, à titre exceptionnel, directement au sein du patrimoine de la slsp)

title: Request for Information _ Creation of The United States Space Academy
description: On Aug. 28, 2026, President Donald J. Trump issued Executive Order (E.O.) 14423, Establishing the United States Space Academy. To answer that call, the United States Space Academy (USSA) is envisioned as a NASA-led, civilian Federal academic institution that combines rigorous technical education with disciplined leadership development, civic responsibility, and a lasting commitment to public service. The Academy will prepare future scientists, engineers, astronauts, pilots, operators, entrepreneurs, civil servants, warfighters, and other leaders to advance American interests across the aerospace sector. Through this Request for Information (RFI), NASA invites each State to submit one official State-sponsored response prepared by a �Responding Entity� and coordinated and formally endorsed by a State Selecting Official. The Governor must designate both the Responding Entity and the State Selecting Official in writing. The response should provide information to support NASA�s assessment of potential locations and operating solutions for the United States Space Academy (USSA). That assessment will inform NASA�s recommendation to the Commission. NASA�s objectives for this announcement are to: Identify potential locations for the permanent establishment of the USSA campus, including a groundbreaking no later than 2027. Identify interim solutions that may allow the USSA to begin instruction in 2028 and facilitate a smooth transition to a permanent campus by 2031. Explore the estimated costs of establishing the USSA and potential state, local, and other non-Federal partnerships that could support its establishment. Information obtained through this RFI will be used by NASA and the Commission to develop the recommended process for selecting the Academy�s permanent physical location, which will be reported to the President for decision. A separate announcement for formal proposals may be issued at a later date. PLEASE NOTE: If there are issues with file submission please email hq-nasa-ussa@mail.nasa.gov. We will respond and provide a box link to upload files. UPDATES MADE AS OF 10.2.26: Question and Answers Document attached. UPDATES MADE AS OF 10.7.26: Updated Question and Answers Document attached. title: V222--RFQ SHUTTLE SERVICES FOR VA CENTRAL CALIFORNIA HEALTH CARE SYSTEM
description: 52.219-27� Notice of Set-Aside for, or Sole-Source Award to, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Concerns Eligible Under the SDVOSB Program. (a) Definition. Service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB) concern means a small business concern (1)(i) Not less than 51 percent of which is owned and controlled by one or more service-disabled veterans or, in the case of any publicly owned business, not less than 51 percent of the stock of which is owned by one or more service-disabled veterans; and (ii) The management and daily business operations of which are controlled by one or more service-disabled veterans or, in the case of a service-disabled veteran with permanent and severe disability, the spouse or permanent caregiver of such veteran; or (2) A small business concern eligible under the SDVOSB Program in accordance with 13 CFR part 128 (see FAR 19.106). (3) Service-disabled veteran, as used in this definition, means a veteran as defined in 38 U.S.C. 101(2), with a disability that is service-connected, as defined in 38 U.S.C. 101(16) and who is registered in the Beneficiary Identification and Records Locator Subsystem, or successor system that is maintained by the Department of Veterans Affairs Veterans Benefits Administration, as a service-disabled veteran. Service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB) concern eligible under the SDVOSB Program means an SDVOSB concern that is designated in the System for Award Management (SAM) as certified by the Small Business Administration (SBA) in accordance with 13 CFR 128.300. title: Request for Information _ Creation of The United States Space Academy
description: On Aug. 28, 2026, President Donald J. Trump issued Executive Order (E.O.) 14423, Establishing the United States Space Academy. To answer that call, the United States Space Academy (USSA) is envisioned as a NASA-led, civilian Federal academic institution that combines rigorous technical education with disciplined leadership development, civic responsibility, and a lasting commitment to public service. The Academy will prepare future scientists, engineers, astronauts, pilots, operators, entrepreneurs, civil servants, warfighters, and other leaders to advance American interests across the aerospace sector. Through this Request for Information (RFI), NASA invites each State to submit one official State-sponsored response prepared by a �Responding Entity� and coordinated and formally endorsed by a State Selecting Official. The Governor must designate both the Responding Entity and the State Selecting Official in writing. The response should provide information to support NASA�s assessment of potential locations and operating solutions for the United States Space Academy (USSA). That assessment will inform NASA�s recommendation to the Commission. NASA�s objectives for this announcement are to: Identify potential locations for the permanent establishment of the USSA campus, including a groundbreaking no later than 2027. Identify interim solutions that may allow the USSA to begin instruction in 2028 and facilitate a smooth transition to a permanent campus by 2031. Explore the estimated costs of establishing the USSA and potential state, local, and other non-Federal partnerships that could support its establishment. Information obtained through this RFI will be used by NASA and the Commission to develop the recommended process for selecting the Academy�s permanent physical location, which will be reported to the President for decision. A separate announcement for formal proposals may be issued at a later date. UPDATES MADE AS OF 10.2.26: Question and Answers Document attached. UPDATES MADE AS OF 10.7.26: Updated Question and Answers Document attached. UPDATES MADE AS OF 10.9.26: RFI extended until November 16, 2026.

title: (EAR048) Repair Fire Alarm System Eareckson Air Station Facilities
description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) / MARKET INTELLIGENCE NOTICE Notice: This is a Request for Information (RFI) for market intelligence and for informational purposes only. This announcement does not constitute a Solicitation or a Request for Proposal (RFP), and no solicitation is currently available. Participation in this RFI is strictly voluntary. The Government will not be obligated to award any agreement or contract because of this RFI, nor will it reimburse respondents for any costs associated with the preparation or submission of information. Submitting a response will not affect a firm�s ability to submit a proposal should a formal solicitation be issued in the future. NAICS Code: 236220 � Commercial and Institutional Building Construction (Note: While Other Transaction Authority is not subject to FAR-based small business regulations, this NAICS code is provided for market research to help the Government understand the size and demographics of the interested industrial base.) Small Business Size Standard: $45 Million PROJECT OVERVIEW The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Alaska District, has a requirement for the site-wide repair and replacement of fire alarm systems at Eareckson Air Station (Shemya Island, Alaska). The project will replace aging and non-compliant fire alarm systems across multiple facilities to meet current UFC 3-600-01, NFPA 72, and life-safety requirements. Existing systems are outdated or non-functional, creating risk to personnel and mission on this remote installation. The Government is now pursuing a wireless (or hybrid wireless) fire alarm architecture that significantly reduces or eliminates the need for extensive buried fiber optic infrastructure, thereby addressing the primary cost driver while achieving full code compliance. Key project components include: � Demolition of existing fire alarm control panels, initiating devices, notification appliances, conduit, and wiring across affected buildings � Installation of a new wireless/hybrid addressable fire alarm system, including wireless devices, gateways/repeaters for campus-wide RF coverage, limited residual hard-wired elements only where essential, and integration with supervisory/monitoring capabilities � RF coverage analysis, specialty detection in hazardous (Class I) locations associated with fuel systems, cybersecurity compliance, multi-shift training, testing, commissioning, and phased turnover � Phased execution by building or geographic area to accommodate remote-island logistics and minimize operational impact Estimated Acquisition Magnitude: Between $27M and $33M Planned Acquisition Strategy: Anticipated to utilize Progressive Design Build via Other Transaction Authority (OTA) The Alaska District is conducting market intelligence to assess industry capability and interest in supporting this effort utilizing an Other Transaction (OT) Agreement under the authority of 10 U.S.C. � 2808a, Facility Construction or Repair: Transactions Other Than Contracts and Grants. This authority is distinct from the Department of Defense prototype OT authorities commonly associated with 10 U.S.C. � 4021 and 4022. This authority is intended for military construction and repair projects that involve testing and experimentation associated with new and emergent construction technologies to achieve potential benefits such as enhanced mission resilience, improved installation support, or cost and schedule reduction. The anticipated delivery method is Progressive Design-Build. Design and Pre-Construction Services - The OT Awardee shall assist the Government collaboratively in advancing the wireless/hybrid fire alarm design, performing RF coverage analysis and site investigations, supporting the UFC waiver process, validating and refining project requirements, and developing progressively more detailed open-book cost and schedule information. Design is expected to advance from approximately 0�15% at award to an agreed interim milestone (target approximately 65%) sufficient for reliable Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) development. Final Design and Construction - Upon reaching an agreed-upon level of design, the Awardee will propose a Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) or Firm-Fixed-Price for final design and construction. If the price is accepted and required funding/approvals (including UFC waiver status) are in place, the Government will authorize Phase 2 execution via modification. Construction is expected to be authorized in staggered packages by building or geographic area to allow early turnover of priority facilities. If a fair and reasonable price cannot be agreed upon, or if other conditions prevent proceeding, the Government retains an �off-ramp� to complete the project via alternative methods while retaining rights to the design developed during Phase 1. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: Please submit your responses to the attached Market Research Intelligence Questionnaire no later than 16 November 2026 at 14:00 Alaska Time (AKT) using one of the following methods: Preferred Method: Complete the questionnaire via the Microsoft Forms link: https://forms.osi.apps.mil/r/DgMYxp3wcZ Alternative Method: Email your completed questionnaire to both of the following individuals: MAJ Quentin Sica at Quentin.Sica@usace.army.mil Theresa Afrank at Theresa.M.Afrank@usace.army.mil Any questions regarding this RFI should be directed to MAJ Quentin Sica or Theresa Afrank using the email addresses above. Disclaimer: This RFI is for market intelligence purposes only. The Government reserves the right to use information received for any purpose and does not commit to issuing a solicitation or awarding an agreement as a result of this notice.
